description.name: Attach Holy with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Hope
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Last Resort (0~2), removed after using Apex Last Resort two times

description.name: Apex Last Resort Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Last Resort level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Hope]

description.name: Apex Last Resort Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Last Resort level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Hope]
